_comment: Consumer adapter config for dispatch_launch.py --adapters. One entry per page role: the command that executes that role's page request. {request} is the page-request JSON path, {result} is where the consumer must write its page-result JSON, {work_dir} is the dispatch directory. A result is accepted only when it validates and echoes its request exactly (collect_launch_receipts rules). Replace the example commands with the owning skills' real entrypoints as S49-08 integration lands; a role with no adapter makes dispatch fail closed for that role rather than pretend.
